name: expectation_completion
description: Complete the author's expect_* assertion inside a real test_that() block (proposals_v1 rank 4). tests/testthat/*.R members are streamed from the CRAN tarballs; a single-line expect_* statement with its setup lines above is cut right after the typed `expect_` partial; the completion is the exact remainder of the author's line (tier-1 exact gate in expect_cut_cursor; tree-sitter structural floor in expect_call_tail).
novelty_note: Fills the named tests gap: no existing family emits test code of any kind - testthat blocks live outside R/ so ast_fim/finish_block never see them, and testthat_skeleton (whole-block drafting) is a different capability. GT = the author's exact line suffix from real CRAN test files; the structural floor alone is intentionally insufficient (any well-formed expect call parses) - only the exact gate scores. Cold completion (no event_diff: the harness scenario_block check forbids it; the previously-completed expectations remain visible in the prefix above).
